summary: Effective ProxyOverrideRules could bypass managed proxy
evidence: Higher-priority Chromium policy can install DIRECT or external proxy overrides.
fix_plan: Require independent effective-state evidence and reject every state except None.

summary: Proxy account could equal child account
evidence: A child-owned proxy process would collapse the privilege boundary.
fix_plan: Reject desired state unless dedicated proxy SID differs from exact child SID.

summary: Signed bundle rollback and same-version replay lacked a durable floor
evidence: Catalog sequence alone did not bind per-bundle version and digest.
fix_plan: Bind exact catalog, bundle, sequence, version and digest acceptance floor.

summary: Extension UX health was confused with network enforcement
evidence: A missing extension could either fail open or unnecessarily disable default-deny enforcement.
fix_plan: Separate CanEnableEnforcement from IsWebsiteRequestReady and keep requests gated on healthy UX.

summary: Request commit and audit/cancellation boundary was ambiguous
evidence: Cancellation or audit delivery failure could hide a committed request or lose its successful audit event.
fix_plan: Use atomic request plus outbox intent commit, pre-commit cancellation gate, operation-owned token and exact intent validation.

summary: Stage 5 test projects were outside the solution gate
evidence: A solution build could pass without compiling new security harnesses.
fix_plan: Add all seven Stage 5 test projects and configuration mappings to guard.sln.

summary: Desired commit had a hard-crash window before first recovery marker
evidence: A crash after durable revoke commit but before scheduling could leave old applied allow state without a wake.
fix_plan: Atomically commit desired state and exact bounded reconcile intent, then require scheduler replace/ack semantics.

summary: Pre-commit cancellation could be swallowed or cross commit
evidence: OperationCanceledException inside broad persistence catch could be misreported; cancellation during commit was ambiguous.
fix_plan: Check cancellation outside catch and pass CancellationToken.None across the atomic commit boundary.

evidence: Key-id substitution could break provenance and revocation when verifier aliases or fallback keys exist.
fix_plan: Upgrade domain separator to guard.web-bundle.v2 and bind signingKeyId into signed bytes.

summary: Extension UX was not bound to the child session
evidence: A healthy extension in an admin or other Windows session could make child website requests appear ready.
fix_plan: Bind exact service-observed child SID, browser digest and authenticated child-session state.

summary: Rejected and rate-limited audits were best effort and delivery could duplicate
evidence: Failure events could disappear on crash and successful delivery had no stable ack identity.
fix_plan: Durably enqueue failure intents and dispatch idempotently by per-attempt IntentId before explicit acknowledgement.

summary: Future-dated extension evidence could appear healthy
evidence: Extension UX path did not call EvaluateEnvelope and IsNotCurrent deliberately ignores future capture times.
fix_plan: Add explicit Future UX state, fail request readiness, and cover future-dated child extension evidence.
